mechanism.name: original exact frozen Arm B function with controlled fixture-only validation-boundary substitution
mechanism.code_identity: Use original f124h_signed_evidence.forward.__code__ unchanged. A new, isolated FunctionType binds a source shim implementing only validate(graph) via f124k_extended_source.validate_public. No mutation of original module globals, code object, original f124h_source.validate, original gradients, sorting, pruning, threshold, or learned weights.
mechanism.input_shape: Public GRAPH_KEYS and EDGE_KEYS identical on F124-H and F124-K; only 7-9-hop role list now accepted by the fixture source. Verify the original forward calls source.validate exactly once and accesses no other source.* attributes.
mechanism.trained_weights: Load both lanes' original 21-parameter Arm B weights from the authenticated original immutable F124-H TRAIN receipt, verify weight sha256 per lane, never train, refit, tune, patch or select.
mechanism.fixture_source: Existing F124-K QUALIFICATION_FIXTURE-only seeds. Evaluate positives and negatives as independent single public graphs (never pair or truth label in forward).
mechanism.blocked_protected_interface: Never provide an entry point accepting F124-K RESERVED_CONFIRM or F124-H reserved first-use. The adapter accepts fixture provenance (lane, seed, vector, QUALIFICATION_FIXTURE) and calls the fixture-only constructor internally; arbitrary graph entry not exposed.
mechanism.failure_policy: Retain every attempted case including original forward bounded-state or message-budget failure, per depth, without retry or selecting better weights. Record fail-closed exception and mark as negative. No altered limits to force success.

controls.scope: Compute public comparators on exact same fixture graphs and report full 48-pair/lane denominator, positive, negative and ranking, depth strata 7/8/9.
controls.cost: Public operation counts and failure counts retained. No qualified superior cost, no direct cross-family control superiority claim from fixture-only data.
controls.success: Validation-only adapter proved structurally identical original Arm B equations, complete fixture cohort evaluated or fail-closed with explicit negative, no protected confirmation, no accepted science.

next: If source-equivalent adapter qualifies on independent fixture with original authentic weights, complete a separate independent protected first-use witness and single-use custody qualification before *any* reserved original inference.
